correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the projective row action from four explicit matrices and H1=(1,1,1,0), H3=(0,0,1,i(1+sqrt5)/2). Exact computation over the Q-basis (1,i,sqrt5,i sqrt5), using field norm inverses, independently found disjoint normalized plane orbits of 160 and 240 elements and closed Galois action. For sigma_i, sigma_sqrt5, sigma_i*sigma_sqrt5 the 400-element fixed counts are 64,160,16. Their simultaneous fixed intersection is 16 Q-rational planes, giving 144 Q(i)-minimal, 48 Q(sqrt5)-minimal, zero Q(sqrt(-5))-minimal, and 192 full biquadratic fields. Orbit-stabilizer yields 16 one-, 96 two-, and 48 four-element Galois orbits. Four sample plane equations were independently verified to belong to the corresponding orbit and have the stated field. Exhaustiveness uses Naskręcki Theorem 1.1 and Corollary 3.1, not an unsupported extrapolation from 400 tests.
